name: LLM Agent Statistical Analysis

specs.name: get_defect_in_last_day
specs.description:
This function makes an HTTP GET request to the backend to retrieve defects that occurred in
the last day. The data returned includes the number of defects and an image related to
the defects in the last day.

specs.name: get_defect_in_last_hour
specs.description:
This function makes an HTTP GET request to the backend to retrieve defects that occurred in
the last hour. The data returned includes the number of defects and an image related to
the defects in the last hour.

specs.name: get_quality_distribution
specs.description:
This function makes an HTTP GET request to the backend to retrieve the quality distribution.
The data returned includes the number of approved and rejected PCB boards and an image containing the pie chart
to represent the distribution.

meta.description: To aid LLM agent in answering statistical analysis queries
